title: Security Settings
subtitle: Manage your security settings, activity, and data preferences.
password.title: Change your password
password.subtitle: Make sure you have a strong password that you don't use on other websites.
password.current_password.label: Current Password
password.new_password.label: New Password
password.confirm_password.label: Confirm New Password
password.strength.label: Password Strength
password.tips.title: Password Security Tips
password.tips.uppercase: Use a mix of uppercase and lowercase letters
password.tips.avoid: Avoid common words and personal information
password.tips.length: Use at least 12 characters for better security
two_factor.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
two_factor.description: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to your account by requiring both your password and a verification code from your mobile phone to log in.
activity.title: Recent Login Activity
activity.description: Monitor your recent login activity to ensure your account hasn't been compromised. We recommend reviewing this regularly.
recovery.title: Account Recovery Options
recovery.description: Set up recovery options to help you regain access to your account if you lose your password or can't log in.
recovery.email.title: Recovery Email
recovery.email.description: A backup email address for account recovery
recovery.modal.title: Add Recovery Email
recovery.modal.label: Recovery Email Address
recovery.modal.helper: We'll send a verification link to this email address.
privacy.export.title: Data Export (GDPR)
privacy.export.description: Under the GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), you have the right to download your personal data in a machine-readable format.
privacy.export.includes.title: Your data export will include:
privacy.export.format: The data will be exported as a JSON file that you can download.
privacy.delete.title: Delete Account (GDPR)
privacy.delete.description: Under the GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), you have the right to request the deletion of your personal data.
privacy.delete.warning.title: Important information about account deletion:
privacy.delete.warning.items.0: This action cannot be undone. All your personal data will be permanently deleted or anonymized.
privacy.delete.warning.items.1: You will lose access to all connected services and applications.
privacy.delete.warning.items.2: Some data may be retained for legal compliance purposes, but will be fully anonymized.
privacy.delete.warning.items.3: Any active subscriptions will be canceled.
privacy.delete.confirmation: You'll need to confirm this action by entering your password.
disable_2fa.title: Disable Two-Factor Authentication
disable_2fa.description: Please enter your 2FA verification code to disable two-factor authentication.
disable_2fa.code.label: Verification Code
